Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly retrieve or synthesize the list of C-suite members at the time of the IPO. The conversation history shows that WebSurfer spent many steps searching for this information but ultimately provided an answer claiming that Shiran Nawi and Daniel Lereya (who are famously co-founders and have been in C-suite roles since the company's inception) were part of the IPO C-suite alongside others, while incorrectly identifying only Eliran Glazer as the new addition. This indicates a hallucination or retrieval failure where the agent either missed the fact that Nawi and Lereya were present or confused the historical leadership team with a different set of executives, leading to the wrong conclusion that only Glazer was missing.
